c74object.name: evi_allpass
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP allpass~ filter delay
c74object.description:
evi_allpass is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_allpass.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_allpass is also available in MSP as: evi.allpass~.
Cubic interpolated allpass filter delay unit. The same structure as MSP allpass~, but with cubic interpolation for smoother high end decays, and a tamed gain coefficient so no digital clipping or aliasing. Quite different than MSP. This abstraction also includes an optional feedbackmix attribute which does ridiculous nonlinear comb effects - you should probably not use this at all (default off).

geninlet.name: delay
geninlet.digest: in ms @min 0.1 @max 1000. Delay time in ms.

geninlet.name: gain
geninlet.digest: Coefficient @min -1 @max 1. Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedforward and feedback paths.

attribute.name: feedbackmix
attribute.description: If > 0, applies saturating gain stage to the internal feedback path.
